PF2EActionForge.Title: PF2E Action Forge
PF2EActionForge.Subtitle: Fast access to character actions
PF2EActionForge.SourceActor.Label: Acting character
PF2EActionForge.SourceActor.Hint: Follow the controlled token automatically, or pin a specific actor from the list.

PF2EActionForge.Actions.Grapple.Name: Grapple

PF2EActionForge.Actions.Trip.Name: Trip
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Trip.Description: Athletics against Reflex DC to knock a creature prone.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Climb.Name: Climb
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Climb.Descriptio: Athletics against an environmental DC to move along an incline or vertical surface.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Lie.Name: Lie
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Lie.Description: Deception against Perception DC; later blocks will protect hidden outcomes.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Demoralize.Name: Demoralize
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Demoralize.Descr: Intimidation against Will DC to frighten a creature.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TreatWounds.Name: Treat Wounds
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TreatWounds.Desc: Medicine with selectable DCs; healing and immunity application arrive in later blocks.
PF2EActionForge.Search.Label: Search actions

PF2EActionForge.Favorites.Hint: Personal shortcuts saved for this Foundry user.

PF2EActionForge.Target.Hint.multiple: This action can use multiple targets. Canvas token targets and Actors from the sidebar can be combined.
PF2EActionForge.Target.DropHint: Drag a visible Actor from the sidebar into this field.
PF2EActionForge.Target.SingleOverflow: Multiple tokens are currently targeted. Only the most recently targeted token is used for this action.
PF2EActionForge.Target.Ready: The target selection is valid for this action.
PF2EActionForge.Target.Required: This action still requires a target.
PF2EActionForge.Notifications.TargetNotA: This action does not use an Actor target.
